name: Voice Transcript Relay
description: Posts what is said in a Discord voice channel — the humans and the agent — into a text channel as it is said, by default the voice channel's own chat. No model calls.

channelIds.label: Voice channels
channelIds.help: Only relay these voice channels (ids). Empty = every room the agent joins.

guildIds.label: Servers
guildIds.help: Only relay voice channels in these servers (ids).

speakerNames.label: Fixed speaker names
speakerNames.help: { "<user id>": "Name" } overrides the Discord display name.

flushMs.label: Collect for (ms)
flushMs.help: 0 = one message per utterance. Default 5000; Discord allows about 30 webhook messages per minute per channel.

to.label: Destination
to.help: Discord target such as channel:<id>. Default: the voice channel's own chat.

accountId.label: Discord account
accountId.help: Which configured Discord account posts. Default: the default account.

webhook.label: Webhook instead
webhook.help: { urlFile, threadId, username }. Posts through a Discord webhook instead of the agent's account.

sessionHeader.label: Join notice
sessionHeader.help: Posted when the agent joins a room. {channelId} and {guildId} are replaced. false to turn off.

showTime.label: Show time
showTime.help: Prefix lines with HH:MM:SS (timeZone to pick the zone).

logFile.label: Log file
logFile.help: Read this file instead of the Gateway's rolling log.
